About the Candidate

Who I Am

Douglas Mangeris is a construction superintendent from Loveland, a Federal Firearms Licensee, and a proud father. He builds things that last — and he intends to bring that same ethic to Washington.

No dynasty. No lobbyist money. No interest in the old political game. Just a neighbor who shows up and a builder who finishes the job.

First, I am a Libertarian Father — I give back. Colorado families deserve leadership that respects personal liberty, supports small businesses, and holds Washington accountable. Your opinion matters. Mine does not.

Construction Super FFL Holder Loveland, CO Proud Dad LP Colorado Nominee

The Game Changer

Real Accountability.
In Real Time.

The technology already exists. Using the MyColorado app, every verified constituent in District 4 gets every House and Senate bill pushed directly to their phone.

You read it. You vote. Those results come to Douglas — your delegate — and he votes accordingly. Then you check, in real time, whether he did exactly that.

No backroom deals. No "trust us." Just total transparency between you and your representative — every single vote.

How It Works
01

Bill drops in Congress — it hits your MyColorado app instantly.

02

You read it. You vote yes or no. Your verified voice is recorded.

03

Your votes come directly to me — I vote as your delegate, not my own agenda.

04

Check in real time whether I voted the way you told me to. Every single time.

We're not replacing the Constitution — we're finally making it work the way it was meant to.

Platform

My Priorities

⏱️
Term Limits

Career politicians have been in Washington since the 1990s. The debt has grown to 5.6 trillion. It's time for term limits and fresh leadership accountable to the people.

💰
Fiscal Accountability

Washington politicians have run up a lavish tab on your dime. We need to leave this country in better shape than we found it — no more generational debt.

🗳️
Election Integrity

America's vote is the only vote of the American people that matters. No foreign aide will be sent overseas without the popular approval of Congress.

🆔
Voter ID

Voter ID will be a requirement for all members of Congress and Senate — verified through DMV and National Records — your civic duty to vote will be protected.

📖
Readable Legislation

All bills will be no longer than 50 pages. It will be a comprehension test — if you don't understand what you are voting on, you do not vote.

🦅
Constitutional Values

We the People wrote the Constitution. We do this. We are the new age. Protecting the liberties and rights enshrined in our founding document for every Coloradan.

The Mission

Not running to win a seat tomorrow.
Running to plant seeds that grow for decades.

Once Coloradans taste real power — once your voice actually drives the vote — the old system will never recover. This is how delegates get held truly accountable to the people.

— Mangeris for the People 2026
